verified_test_evidence.aggregate_barback_failure: Stale exact migration-count assertion expected 89 and found 92

top_10_blockers: Authenticated staff can mutate inventory-relevant fields on existing Events.
Authenticated/scoped staff can insert Events with final status and bypass review.
Anonymous users can execute privileged backup and prune functions.
Realtime Scale Bridge trusts unauthenticated client-supplied weights.
Barback outbox quota fallback can silently discard queued submissions.
Unsigned iOS deep-link configuration can redirect the app to an arbitrary backend.
No live app-specific privacy policy, terms, and support URL are ready.
Arboleaf decoding/calibration is not sufficiently physically certified.
iOS release candidate is untagged, unmerged, version/build 1.0/1, with stale origin/main.
Deployed Edge Function source is incomplete and not fully reproducible.

findings.description: Venue staff can update all Event columns; the status trigger does not guard non-status changes.
findings.risk: Approved inventory history can be rewritten without review or audit.
findings.recommended_fix: Replace broad update policy with narrow server-authorized operations and block protected field changes.

findings.description: Existing insert policies do not force PENDING and permit client-selected final status/source.
findings.risk: Review, firewall, and audit can be bypassed.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a server guard enforcing source/status contracts.

findings.description: Three backup/prune SECURITY DEFINER functions are executable by anon without caller authorization.
findings.risk: Anonymous backup creation, pruning, and resource abuse.
findings.recommended_fix: Revoke anon/public execute and add explicit admin/service authorization.

findings.description: Realtime broadcast accepts client-supplied grams and stable values without trustworthy session/scope/source validation.
findings.risk: Forged weight can corrupt inventory.
findings.recommended_fix: Use an authenticated server-owned channel with device, session, scope, freshness, range, and sequence validation.

findings.description: Quota recovery saves only the newest half of queued entries without alerting the user.
findings.risk: Live Event submissions can be silently lost.
findings.recommended_fix: Fail visibly and preserve immutable pending entries with tested recovery.

findings.description: Unsigned deep-link configuration can set an arbitrary backend URL and key in localStorage.
findings.risk: Phishing, credential capture, and data diversion.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove from public build or require signed, pinned, allowlisted configuration.

findings.description: No live app-specific privacy policy, terms, or support URL is ready.
findings.risk: App Review rejection and privacy compliance gap.
findings.recommended_fix: Publish app-specific legal and support pages matching actual permissions and data flows.

findings.description: Arboleaf conversion rule lacks adequate physical certification and conflicts with Scale Lab documentation.
findings.risk: Incorrect weight or bottle percentage can corrupt inventory.
findings.recommended_fix: Create authoritative protocol evidence and a physical reference-weight test matrix; gate unsupported devices.

findings.description: iOS candidate is only on a feature branch, untagged, origin/main is stale, and version/build remain 1.0/1.
findings.risk: Submitted binary cannot be reproduced or identified safely.
findings.recommended_fix: Create reviewed release branch/tag, increment version/build, and verify archive provenance.

findings.description: Approximately 14 deployed functions have no canonical current-repository source.
findings.evidence: 20 deployed functions listed; only a subset exists in current repos
findings.risk: Production behavior cannot be reliably reviewed, reproduced, or rolled back.
findings.recommended_fix: Recover exact deployed source and assign canonical ownership.

findings.description: Legacy v1 session tokens are accepted without signature verification.
findings.risk: Legacy token forgery.
findings.recommended_fix: Measure usage, expire legacy path, and require signed tokens.

findings.description: Bundled Barback and Manager pages are materially older than deployed web.
findings.evidence: iOS barback.html 2997 lines vs web 8261; manager 2531 vs 3690
findings.risk: Entry path changes security and workflow behavior.
findings.recommended_fix: Define a controlled source-of-truth asset sync.

findings.description: Six local scripts are missing and multiple third-party scripts load at runtime without SRI.
findings.evidence: portal-config.js, barinv-build.js, barinv-resolver.js, qnksTarget.js, qnksDecoder.js, arboleafScaleService.js
findings.risk: Startup, offline, and supply-chain failures.
findings.recommended_fix: Package pinned assets locally and add build checks.

findings.description: Several Admin option labels use unescaped names in innerHTML.
findings.risk: Stored user-controlled labels can execute script in manager context.
findings.recommended_fix: Use textContent/DOM APIs or consistent escaping and add malicious-label tests.

findings.description: Default privileges grant execute on new functions to anon; 51 functions expose anon execute.
findings.evidence: remote schema dump default privileges near lines 11431-11434
findings.risk: Future privileged RPCs can be exposed accidentally.
findings.recommended_fix: Revoke default anon execute and explicitly grant per function.

findings.description: public.backfill_night_bars has ambiguous night_id.
findings.risk: Broken maintenance operation and failed quality gate.
findings.recommended_fix: Correct in a new migration and add lint regression.

findings.description: Barback scope security test has a stale exact migration-count assertion.
findings.risk: Aggregate suite is not green.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert required migration versions/security properties instead of total count.

findings.description: iOS npm test is a placeholder failure and no unified release CI exists.
findings.evidence: iOS package.json and audit test inventory
findings.risk: Release status depends on manual evidence.
findings.recommended_fix: Create deterministic JS, SQL, rollback, UI, firmware, and build gates.

findings.description: Web loads only the newest 200 matching rows and has no visible paging.
findings.risk: Managers cannot inspect older matching Events.
findings.recommended_fix: Add server-side paging consistent with iOS.

findings.description: CSV action validation omits active operational actions such as TAKEN/SOLD.
findings.risk: Valid workflows cannot be imported consistently.
findings.recommended_fix: Define one server-owned action enum and consume it everywhere.

findings.description: auto_approve_events is create/list only and cannot be edited on an existing session.
findings.risk: Manager must replace a session to correct the setting.
findings.recommended_fix: Add manager-authorized update with audit and clear UX.

findings.description: Barback JWT, session details, and outbox entries are plaintext in localStorage.
findings.risk: Shared/lost device exposure and XSS amplification.
findings.recommended_fix: Minimize stored data and use platform secure storage where possible.

findings.description: Service worker root paths do not match GitHub Pages subpath; Barback unregisters all workers and clears all caches.
findings.risk: Offline reload failure and cross-surface cache interference.
findings.recommended_fix: Correct scope/versioning and remove global cache destruction.

findings.description: Local station offset changes saved/published weight without manager approval or audit.
findings.risk: Hidden calibration can bias inventory.
findings.recommended_fix: Make calibration server-authorized, bounded, versioned, and audited.

findings.description: Multiple active scale stacks use different stability thresholds.
findings.risk: Divergent readings and competing ownership.
findings.recommended_fix: Select one authoritative adapter contract and shared stability rules.

findings.description: Calibration is RAM-only and device security, identity, battery, OTA, and release process are absent.
findings.risk: Custom hardware is not supportable in public production.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep beta-only and add production hardware lifecycle.

findings.description: No complete Android/iPhone/iPad/scanner/BLE/offline event-night certification matrix exists.
findings.risk: Platform-specific blockers may appear during live service.
findings.recommended_fix: Run and preserve a documented physical-device release matrix.

findings.description: Privacy manifest, metadata, screenshots, review notes, test account, and permission reconciliation are missing.
findings.risk: Submission rejection or incomplete review.
findings.recommended_fix: Prepare and validate the complete App Store package.

findings.description: MiniSSD is about 96 percent full with about 38 GiB available.
findings.risk: Next full release backup may fail.
findings.recommended_fix: Apply verified retention and secondary-storage policy.

findings.description: No authoritative version-controlled source matching the live site was found.
findings.risk: Website cannot be reproduced or rolled back safely.
findings.recommended_fix: Recover live source into a controlled repository.

findings.description: Smart Scale claims exceed certification evidence and Events visuals are stale.
findings.evidence: BARINV.ca copy versus Scale Lab and current product
findings.risk: Customer, legal, and App Review inconsistency.
findings.recommended_fix: Align claims and screenshots with certified capabilities.

findings.description: Exact-once review audit does not cover final-status insert bypasses or protected non-status mutation.
findings.risk: Inventory-changing actions may lack accountable history.
findings.recommended_fix: Expand immutable Event and audit contract after policy closure.

findings.description: Broad CORS, raw backend error details, and ambiguous service-key fallback remain.
findings.risk: Information disclosure and configuration fragility.
findings.recommended_fix: Standardize CORS, public errors, internal logging, and explicit key-role selection.

findings.description: extendSession exists without reachable UI and old deployed management functions overlap.
findings.risk: Confusing ownership and untested behavior.
findings.recommended_fix: Decide supported lifecycle and remove/deprecate dead paths.

findings.description: auth_session_active returns TRUE and is misleading.
findings.risk: Future callers may assume real enforcement.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove or implement correctly with tests.

findings.description: Web and iOS use very large divergent single-file HTML implementations.
findings.evidence: iOS index 53155 lines; web index 12087 lines
findings.risk: Security and feature fixes drift between surfaces.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract versioned shared modules and a generated asset pipeline incrementally.

findings.description: iOS exposes action choice but blocks non-keep values because no secure server contract exists.
findings.risk: UI implies an unavailable capability.
findings.recommended_fix: Hide/disable clearly or add a separately audited correction RPC.

findings.description: BARINV.ca Events visuals show an older UI.
findings.risk: Public documentation does not match product.
findings.recommended_fix: Publish current redacted screenshots after UI stabilization.

findings.description: Pricing, trial, licensing, and dedicated support flow are unclear.
findings.risk: Prospects and App Review lack service/access clarity.
findings.recommended_fix: Publish owner-approved commercial and support information.

findings.description: Rendered browser/mobile inspection was unavailable; static HTTP/source checks only.
findings.risk: Visual or interactive regressions may remain.
findings.recommended_fix: Run automated and physical responsive browser audit.

findings.description: Deployed integration exists but source ownership and complete sandbox failure tests are incomplete.
findings.evidence: remote function inventory and repo source inventory
findings.risk: Sync duplicates or stale inventory may be missed.
findings.recommended_fix: Recover source and run sandbox reconciliation/idempotency matrix.

findings.description: Some Admin operational paths intentionally insert APPROVED Events directly.
findings.evidence: web index.html around 4710-4714 and transfer paths
findings.risk: Policy and audit semantics are fragmented.
findings.recommended_fix: Centralize allowed system-origin final inserts behind audited server APIs.

findings.description: Local web main is stale and old branches/tags/backups are numerous.
findings.risk: Operators may build or deploy from the wrong point.
findings.recommended_fix: Create owner-approved branch/tag retention and release-source policy.

findings.description: Scale packet/debug logging is verbose.
findings.risk: Noise, performance impact, and operational detail exposure.
findings.recommended_fix: Gate and redact diagnostics in production.

findings.description: Scale Lab has no remote and is heavily dirty with deleted tests/modules and untracked evidence.
findings.risk: Scale evidence is not reproducible or recoverable.
findings.recommended_fix: Preserve and inventory state, establish canonical branch/remote, restore a green baseline.

findings.description: Names such as TEST_MODE_BARBACK and stale phase comments do not reflect production behavior.
findings.risk: Reviewer confusion.
findings.recommended_fix: Rename and update comments after behavior is locked.

findings.description: Old backup branches and tags are numerous.
findings.risk: Release navigation is noisy.
findings.recommended_fix: Archive only after verified bundles and owner-approved retention.

findings.description: Website Events preview remains old.
findings.risk: Minor credibility mismatch.
findings.recommended_fix: Refresh with the next marketing release.

findings.description: ESP32 README calls working firmware a stub and runbook claims exceed evidence.
findings.risk: Engineers may follow incorrect assumptions.
findings.recommended_fix: Reconcile documentation with tested hardware state.

next_approval_needed: Review and prioritize the audit findings; authorize a separately scoped P0 remediation plan. No fixes were made during this audit.
